June 27, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Cincinnati Financial Corp increased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 0.86% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cincinnati Financial Corp bought 7,950 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.08% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 932,950 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $85.15M, up from 925,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cincinnati Financial Corp who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $766.44B market cap company. The stock increased 0.68% or $0.675 during the last trading session, reaching $99.755. About 5.97M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 41.28% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.71% the S&P500. The institutional investor held 81,092 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.61 million, down from 85,642 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
